ai_summary.key_headline: Tartan Army's Midfield Runners Encounter Atlas Lions' Technical Precision

scotland.philosophy: Disciplined low-block, rapid flank transitions, and late midfield runs into the box.

morocco.philosophy: Technical possession with high-speed flank combinations and a structured mid-block.

tactical_insights: Napoli's Scott McTominay and his late runs into the box will be Scotland's main weapon against the AFCON 2025 champions.
Achraf Hakimi's overlaps on the right wing will test Andrew Robertson's defensive positioning.
Sofyan Amrabat will lock down the central areas, stopping Scotland's quick transitions from deep.
